question: Should OpenClaw add bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets now, and what redaction, scope, retention, export, and command-binding boundaries must they follow?
rationale: Current main has log and terminal primitives but not dashboard widgets, and exposing logs or command output in a persistent operator dashboard depends on unmerged dashboard substrate plus security choices automation cannot make.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model first, then implement widgets against approved contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Read-Only Existing Data
options.body: Allow only a focused widget design that reads existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output summaries, excluding new command execution or generic command bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Builtins
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context and ask contributors to focus on external plugins or missing plugin APIs until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model first, then implement widgets against approved contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The Control UI plugin-tab seam and product/security precedent for bundled UI plugin tabs came through the Logbook work he authored and merged.
